messages:
Maria (CEO): leaving a short follow-up from the all-hands. can leadership drop quick notes on two things: the north-star message we should use externally, and the three-sentence positioning vs competitors. keep replies brief.
Ajay (CTO): north-star: "Make inference predictable and cheap to operate." positioning: we combine a high-throughput runtime with ops-first tooling (observability, rollouts, fallbacks). competitors split between cheap-only stacks, opaque hosted APIs, or ops-heavy OSS.
Lena (Head Product): product lens: emphasize runtime+ops for engineers building features. top line for marketing: "Inference engineered for production."
Tom (Sales): field color: customers ask first about SLA, then integration effort, then cost. two sales motions: PLG for feature teams, sales-assisted for Dedicated/Private.
Priya (Eng): small ask: never publish a single latency number without test config. ops-bot: weekly perf exports at /dashboards/perf-summary.
Sam (Research): competitor note: some niche vendors push extreme quantization, cost wins but fail at enterprise SLAs. public messaging should call out our graceful-degradation story (fallback models, regional routing).
Darci (Strategy): suggested succinct positioning (3 sentences): 1) We provide a developer-first inference platform. 2) We deliver predictable SLOs, rollout controls, and observability. 3) We reduce per-token cost with batching, caching, and recommended quant configs.
Marta (Marketing): for external hero variations: A) "Predictable inference, wherever you run it." B) "Inference that behaves in production." we can A/B both on the homepage and signup flow.
Tom (Sales): request: GTM needs two one-pagers ready this week: SLA+integration for enterprise, and quickstart+cost-savings for PLG.
Priya (Eng): i'll post a BYOM (bring-your-own-model) checklist in #eng: quant compatibility, max-seq, memory footprint, KV cache behavior, recommended test harness.
Ajay (CTO): engineering pledge: we'll maintain a curated verified-model catalog (benchmarks with configs) and an escape hatch for BYOM labeled experimental.
Sam (Research): propose quarterly cadence for verified-model reviews + a simple rubric. Darci, can you own?
Darci (Strategy): yes, will set quarterly reviews and publish the rubric.
Maria (CEO): great. final quick Q: how public with perf grids? full numbers or tiers?
Lena (Head Product): publish vetted grids for verified models and tiered summaries for marketing. always attach test config.
Marta (Marketing): will prepare marketing-friendly tiers + link to tech appendix with detailed grids.
Tom (Sales): thanks, that helps rebut objections on demos.
Maria (CEO): ok, i'll synthesize into a 1-page README + two one-pagers (PLG + enterprise) and share later today. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
Ajay (CTO): happy to review the README.
Priya (Eng): posting BYOM draft in ~30m.
Sam (Research): adding a competitor appendix for the deck.
Marta (Marketing): queuing the A/B test for Monday.
Maria (CEO): closing thread; will post artifacts when ready. :rocket:
